ei.title: 함축 의미 추론 — 완벽보다 나은 진전의 가치
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고2

fullPassage: Everyone’s heard the expression don’t let the perfect become the enemy of the good. If you want to get over an obstacle so that your idea can become the solution-based policy you’ve long dreamed of, you can’t have an all-or-nothing mentality. You have to be willing to alter your idea and let others influence its outcome. You have to be okay with the outcome being a little different, even a little less, than you wanted. Say you’re pushing for a clean water act. Even if what emerges isn’t as well-funded as you wished, or doesn’t match how you originally conceived the bill, you’ll have still succeeded in ensuring that kids in troubled areas have access to clean water. That’s what counts, that they will be safer because of your idea and your effort. Is it perfect? No. Is there more work to be done? Absolutely. But in almost every case, helping move the needle forward is vastly better than not helping at all.

questions.passage: Everyone’s heard the expression don’t let the perfect become the enemy of the good. If you want to get over an (A)[obstacle / opportunity] so that your idea can become the solution-based policy you’ve long dreamed of, you can’t have an all-or-nothing mentality. You have to be willing to (B)[alter / maintain] your idea and let others influence its outcome. You have to be okay with the outcome being a little different, even a little less, than you wanted. Say you’re pushing for a clean water act. Even if what emerges isn’t as well-funded as you wished, or doesn’t match how you originally conceived the bill, you’ll have still succeeded in ensuring that kids in troubled areas have access to clean water. That’s what counts, that they will be safer because of your idea and your (C)[effort / failure]. Is it perfect? No. Is there more work to be done? Absolutely. But in almost every case, helping move the needle forward is vastly better than not helping at all.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 장애물을 극복하고 아이디어를 변경하며 노력하는 것이 중요하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① opportunity(기회)는 obstacle(장애물)의 반의어
✅ ② obstacle — alter — effort: 원문 그대로 ←정답
❌ ③ maintain(유지하다)은 alter(변경하다)의 반의어
❌ ④ failure(실패)는 effort(노력)의 반의어
det.tip: obstacle = 장애물, alter = 변경하다, effort = 노력

det.korean: 기꺼이 아이디어를 바꾸고, 다른 사람이 결과에 영향을 미치게 하며, 원래 구상했던 법안과 달라야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① unwilling(꺼리는)은 willing의 반의어
❌ ② ignore(무시하다)는 influence의 반의어
❌ ③ abandoned(포기한)는 conceived의 반의어

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 아이디어를 변경하고 다른 사람이 결과에 영향을 미치도록 기꺼이 해야 한다.
det.analysis: be + 형용사 구문. will(동사) → willing(형용사)

questions.passage: If you want to get over an obstacle so that your idea can become the solution-based policy you've long __________ (dream) of, you can't have an all-or-nothing mentality.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 오래 꿈꿔온 해결책 기반 정책이 되도록 장애물을 극복하고 싶다면, 모 아니면 도 사고방식을 가질 수 없다.
det.analysis: have + 과거분사(현재완료). dream → dreamed (또는 dreamt)

questions.passage: Everyone’s heard the expression don’t let the perfect become the enemy of the good. If you want to get over an obstacle so that your idea can become the solution-based policy you’ve long dreamed of, you can’t have __________. You have to be willing to alter your idea and let others influence its outcome. You have to be okay with the outcome being a little different, even a little less, than you wanted. Say you’re pushing for a clean water act. Even if what emerges isn’t as well-funded as you wished, or doesn’t match how you originally conceived the bill, you’ll have still succeeded in ensuring that kids in troubled areas have access to clean water. That’s what counts, that they will be safer because of your idea and your effort. Is it perfect? No. Is there more work to be done? Absolutely. But in almost every case, helping move the needle forward is vastly better than not helping at all.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 오래 꿈꿔온 정책을 실현하고 싶다면, ____을 가질 수 없다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① the solution-based policy — 해결책 기반 정책: 이것은 목표
❌ ② the enemy of the good — 좋은 것의 적: 문맥 부적합
❌ ③ a clean water act — 깨끗한 물법: 예시일 뿐
✅ ④ an all-or-nothing mentality — 모 아니면 도 사고방식 ←정답
det.tip: all-or-nothing mentality = 모 아니면 도 사고방식
